Visit your nearest Kangaroo Kids Preschool for a unique celebration of a new beginning!

VIJAYADASHMI ADMISSIONS OPEN NOW!

You never really know where your child’s first little step will lead.
And that is the exciting part.

Because while we can’t predict who they’ll become, we can assure them the right beginning, one that understands who they are, what sparks their curiosity, and gives them the space to grow.

This Vijayadashami, we invite you to celebrate their first steps into learning with experiences as unique as they are.

At your nearest Kangaroo Kids.

Vijayadashmi celebrates the beginning of light, clarity, and new paths. 

A truly blessed beginning is one tailored to who your child actually is. At Kangaroo Kids, we replace one-size-fits-all routines with personalized attention. We tune into their pace, passions, and unique learning style from day one, because no two journeys to success look the same.

Start a journey that champions their individuality at your nearest Kangaroo Kids Preschool.

Give. Reuse. Grow greener.

Every toy handed down, every backpack reused, every battery recycled responsibly — it all adds up. Kangaroo Kids Bangalore has joined the Hamleys Green Club, and we're inviting every family in the city to be part of it — not just ours. Give any one of these: 3 gently used toys, 2 backpacks, or 10 used batteries, and receive 30 minutes of free play at a Hamleys Play Zone, an exclusive discount voucher, and a Certificate of Goodness.

📍 Drop your donations at any Kangaroo Kids Bangalore centre, until 15th September 2026.

To every little photographer who picked up a phone and found their own frame this World Photography Day, thank you for showing us how you see. And to the parents who handed over the phone and let them look, thank you for trusting their eyes.

Kangaroo Kids presents an Independence Day Story Series!🇮🇳✨

A series that takes us back in time to meet the brave minds that helped shape India’s journey to freedom.

In Episode 2, let's witness the art of taking responsible actions by young soldiers who created the army and helped freedom fighters in a way no one could even think of. 

Because sometimes, even the smallest hands can make the biggest difference.

Watch Episode 2 and discover how they played a big part in India’s freedom story.

Save this story for your little one’s story time!

⏰ Only 2 days left! If your little one hasn't clicked their entry yet, now's the time.

No need to overthink it — the best entries are the ones that just happen. A toy they won't put down, a snack they're posing next to, a random corner of the house that suddenly seems fascinating. Let them lead, camera and all.

Submit by 15th August — don't miss it!

📸 Tag kangarookidspreschool_official

Kangaroo Kids presents an Independence Day story series 🇮🇳✨
A series that takes us back in time to meet the great minds who helped shape India’s freedom.

Did you know the British once tried to LOCK UP the news? 

They wanted to control what people could read, hear and share. Imagine living in a world where no one was allowed to tell the news!

But one Hero had a super idea.

Watch Episode 1 to discover how this secret voice helped in India’s fight for freedom!

Drop a “Hi” in the comments if you waved back at Kan! 

Follow along so you don’t miss Story 2!
